display_name: Dark Forest Frontier V2 — Terrain & Props
style_reference: Darkest Dungeon 2 inspired painterly NPR. Do not copy specific assets; use the value structure and readability language. Sibling profile to darkest_dungeon_2_like_kon.json (units) — same rendering language, different palette family for environment vs. player-faction assets.
goal: Readable dark-fantasy RTS terrain and props with inked silhouettes, matte painterly materials, and the biome's established corrupted-forest accent language (magenta/pink for corruption, dull red for hostile markers, cyan reserved for KON-owned/base-adjacent elements only).

prompt_requirements: orthographic or three-quarter top-down game-asset reference framing
clean isolated silhouette, no ground plane clutter beyond the asset itself
large readable shapes — must be identifiable at RTS zoomed-out camera distance
no UI, text, frame, heavy background, or tiny surface detail
dark painterly values with at most one controlled emissive accent color per asset
meshy_guidance.positive_prompt: stylized dark fantasy RTS terrain prop, Darkest-Dungeon-2-like painterly inked rendering, strong black silhouette, chunky readable shapes, matte moss, bark, stone and bone, controlled single-color bioluminescent or ember accent, orthographic game asset reference, high contrast shadows, no photorealism
meshy_guidance.negative_prompt: photorealistic, glossy plastic, noisy AI texture, tiny surface detail, soft low-contrast silhouette, bright cheerful colors, modern materials, sci-fi, UI, text, watermark, realistic photo-scan look

accent_base.note: cyan — reserve for BASE_PLOT_MARKER and other KON-owned/base-adjacent assets only, do not use generically

accent_corrupted.note: magenta/pink — the biome's established corrupted-mushroom accent, use for content/mystery/corruption-coded assets

accent_hostile.note: dull red/ember — hostile/Deom-coded assets only (outpost markers, enemy structures)

godot_expectations.lighting: cool moonlit key light, magenta fill near corrupted features per DARK_FOREST_FRONTIER_V2_STATUS.md
godot_expectations.camera: orthographic top-down preview plus in-game readability check at default RTS zoom
godot_expectations.pivot_convention: per BLENDER_EXPORT_GUIDE.md by category — tile-center-at-top-surface for ground markers/terrain tiles, tile-center-at-ground for props/blockers, trunk-base for trees
godot_expectations.animation_status: not applicable — static props/terrain, no rig or animation needed
